1. My personal preference is x > z > w > y

- If x rejects me (possible due to high competition), I want z as my next choice
- If z also rejects me, I want w next (where I have high priority)

- Lead with my most preferred school
- Have a strategic backup plan
- End with a school where I'm high priority
- Minimize risk of being unmatched
